verdict.rationale: Decagon's integrations page claims the agent can "handle escalations smoothly across chat, email, and voice channels." Its proactive-agents page says it carries conversation history and customer context across sessions, which suggests context is kept. Neither describes what the human agent actually receives at handoff. Missing for 10: documented transfer of the full transcript to the human agent, an auto-generated escalation summary, passing of collected customer details or fields into the helpdesk ticket, an explicit no-repeat guarantee, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
